data_provenance.source: FRED (BLS — Employment Cost Index: Total compensation: All Civilian, SA)

known_stress_episodes.label: GFC wage deceleration
known_stress_episodes.note: Total-compensation growth decelerated sharply after the GFC as labor markets slackened; YoY fell toward ~1.4%.

known_stress_episodes.label: 2021-23 wage-inflation surge
known_stress_episodes.note: Post-COVID labor shortage drove ECI YoY to ~5.1% (mid-2022) — the key wage-price-spiral scare feeding Fed tightening; real, not a data error.
